title: Choose a fallback
summary: Dart: Choose a fallback. Give name the value Asha.
introduction: String? can hold text or null. ?? chooses a fallback when the value is null.

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.
name starts as null. The ?? operator supplies Guest.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Using ! on null causes an error.
